verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI clearly publishes an API reference: the agent-instructions docs mention an option to skip it, and a probe found a live OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json. Nothing in the pack shows that this reference is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples. The no-code Playground is a separate transcription tool rather than an interactive API reference, so it only hints at runnability. Missing for 10: documented interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable request examples within the reference, hands-on or independent corroboration of interactivity.
